picker.details_no_menu: This block does not bring any menu rows of its own.

picker.rows_other_drift: These fields also differ from the catalogue

picker.help_blocks_vs_rows: A block is a group of menu rows that together make up one feature — for example "Calendar" or "Chat". A menu row is a single entry in your club's menu, with an address, a role it needs, and a few other fields. The "Blocks" tab switches whole features on or off, the "Menu rows" tab shows you every single row and where its value differs from the catalogue.
picker.help_actions: Apply writes the catalogue value into your menu. Pin keeps your value and tells the catalogue to leave it alone from now on. Adjust catalogue writes nothing — it sends a note to the development team because your value would also be right for the other clubs. The question that helps you choose between the two: should this value also apply to the other clubs? Yes → Adjust catalogue. No → Pin.
picker.help_setup: For the first setup: pick a profile at the top — it proposes the matching blocks and highlights them, but writes nothing yet. Then work through the highlighted blocks one by one: "Enable" switches the block on and creates its menu rows. If a block is already on but missing menu rows, it offers "Complete menu" instead, which creates exactly the rows that are missing. Individual rows are listed on the "Menu rows" tab, where "Add to menu" fetches them.
picker.help_saving: This page has no Save button, and you don't need one: every action — "Enable", "Complete menu", "Disable", "Add to menu", "Apply", "Pin", "Unpin" — tells you first what it is about to do and then saves it right away. What you see on screen is always the current state.
picker.help_pinned: A pinned field is yours. The catalogue no longer suggests a value for it and will not write it in future updates either. You can undo the pin at any time with "Unpin".
picker.help_promise: This page deletes nothing and never changes an existing row without your consent.
picker.enable_dialog_intro: Here you choose which menu rows are created. Anything you leave unticked is simply not created — nothing is lost, and you can add it later at any time from the menu rows list.
picker.help_customize: The «Customize» tab shows or hides fields in the forms, for everybody who uses this app. Hiding does not delete any data. «Restore defaults» sets a group back to the default. You change the values of the lists in the linked editor.

plan.block_disabled: will be switched off — the menu entries remain and are only hidden, the data stays unchanged
plan.block_enabled: The area is available to you and your members from now on.
plan.block_enabled_dependency: This area is switched on as well, because the one you chose builds on it.
plan.block_withheld: This area is currently not available to you and stays off.

plan.field_pinned: From now on you maintain this field yourselves and the catalogue no longer overwrites it.
plan.field_unpinned: This field is maintained by the catalogue again.
plan.menu_attached: This entry appears anew in your main menu.
plan.menu_children: This menu entry gets the additionally chosen sub-entries.
plan.menu_created: This menu entry will be created.
plan.menu_reactivated: This previously removed menu entry becomes visible again.
plan.menu_shared: This menu entry already exists and will be made available to you.
plan.seed_created: A starter record is created for it, which you can adjust afterwards.

customize.intro: Here you decide which fields appear in the forms. Hiding does not delete anything: the data stays saved and the field comes back as soon as you show it again. The setting applies to everybody who uses this app.
customize.reset_confirm: All fields of this group are shown again as the catalogue defines them. Nothing is deleted. Do you want to continue?
customize.lists_note: You change the entries of these lists in their own editor, where you can rename, add or hide them.
